## Changes

- Import SSH keys as shared items from SecureCRT, PuTTY, and OpenSSH, and link imported sessions to them. SecureCRT global and personal key settings are included.
- Show key paths and missing files in the import preview. Handle encrypted PKCS#8 keys without requesting a passphrase during import.
- Add persistent terminal highlight rules.
- Improve responsive tabs and SSH agent activity indicators.
- Update website screenshots and add a theme demonstration.

The WebView terminal and playback remain the default. Native terminal work remains behind a development build option.

## Import limits

Key files stay in their current location. Passwords and key passphrases are not imported. OpenSSH imports use the first configured IdentityFile. Existing sessions are unchanged, and duplicate sessions are skipped.

## Downloads

Signed setup EXE and MSI packages, plus portable ZIP files, are available for x64 and ARM64. SHA256SUMS.txt contains the download checksums.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/bpbp-boop/resesh/compare/v0.10.1...v0.11.0)
